summary: End-to-end testing of the new WelcomeDemo (post-registration 'Prenota una demo') flow and Super Admin 'Richieste demo' area. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter96_demo_requests.py — 10/10 pytest cases pass. Covers: register-organization sets welcome_demo='pending', /api/demo/welcome prefill (email lowercased & disabled, nome/organizzazione prefilled), /api/demo/slots returns slots per SA config (Mon-Fri 10-12), /api/demo/requests creates request (persists in demo_requests, flips welcome_demo→'requested', upserts Lead with demo_status='da_confermare'), invalid slot_key → 409, empty name → 400, /demo/welcome/dismiss sets welcome_demo='dismissed' (idempotent), /api/platform/demo/requests list+filter+PATCH status (valid=200, invalid=400, missing=404), non-superadmin → 401/403. Frontend (Playwright, https://manage-events-12.preview.emergentagent.com): (1) auto-registration via /registrati redirects to /app and welcome-demo-dialog opens automatically with correct title 'Scopri CRMEvent con una demo gratuita', prefills nome='Mario Rossi', email disabled & lowercased, organizzazione prefilled; (2) 'Richiedi una demo' button is disabled without slot + nome, enabled once both set; selecting demo-day-YYYY-MM-DD + demo-time-… + typing note works; submit transitions to welcome-demo-done ('Richiesta inviata!…'); (3) after submit, reload does NOT auto-reopen the dialog (welcome_demo=='requested'); (4) header-demo-button is visible for trial orgs, opens the SAME WelcomeDemo dialog without navigation, on /app and on /eventi (url unchanged); (5) 'Non ora' dismisses, backend persists welcome_demo='dismissed', reload confirms no auto-reopen; (6) mobile 390x844: dialog fits (width=390, computed max-h, overflow-y=auto, scrollHeight>clientHeight), both buttons visible/usable; (7) Super Admin /piattaforma/richieste-demo renders demo-requests-page with 2 rows (name, org, email+phone, preferred date/time, sent date, note, status select), demo-req-filter switches to empty state when filtering 'annullata'; status select demo-req-status-{id} successfully PATCHes status to 'completata' / 'confermata'. All TEST_* orgs/users/leads/demo_requests cleaned from DB.

integration_issues.flow: Reopen WelcomeDemo via header-demo-button after a successful request
integration_issues.issue: On second open (post-submit) the dialog sometimes renders with empty prefill (nome/email blank) and 'Al momento non ci sono orari disponibili' even though /api/demo/slots still returns slots in pytest. Possibly a stale state issue in WelcomeDemo start(): when the user is in state 'requested' and reopens via the event listener, the previously-filled `f` is reset and the slot the user already picked is still being filtered. Non-blocking — the primary flow (auto-open → submit → done) works. Observed on /eventi.

action_items: (Minor) In WelcomeDemo.jsx, consider refetching slots and resetting prefill explicitly inside the 'welcome-demo:open' handler so that subsequent header-triggered openings always render with up-to-date prefill and slot list — avoid relying on previous component state.

Trial-only visibility of header-demo-button is enforced in Layout.jsx — verified from UI (QA non-trial admin sees 'Assistenza' instead).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_iter96_demo_requests.py (replaces test_iter90_welcome_demo.py which still references the removed /demo/welcome/book endpoint — main agent should mark that older test file as obsolete). The main user-facing flow is confirmed working on both desktop and mobile. One minor UX note: reopening the dialog via header-demo-button after a successful submit may render with empty prefill/empty slot list; worth a small follow-up fix in WelcomeDemo.jsx start() handler but not a blocker.
rca of the issue: Minor reopen glitch RCA (frontend only): In /app/frontend/src/components/WelcomeDemo.jsx the 'welcome-demo:open' handler calls start(), which does Promise.all([/demo/welcome, /demo/slots]) and setF(w.data.prefill). If the user already submitted (welcome_demo='requested'), the API still returns a valid prefill, but the local `f` state previously contained an obsolete slot_key, and `done` flag may not be reset in a timely manner. Mitigation: inside start() explicitly `setF({})` first OR add a dependency on user.welcome_demo so the handler re-fires. Also, in the 'no slots' case we rely on silently-caught catch in start() — adding a toast would make failure visible.
